objects.name: Unpatched Windows Search URI Vulnerability Lets Attackers Steal NTLMv2 Hashes
objects.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed details of an unpatched issue that could be exploited to disclose a user's NTLMv2 hash to the attacker. Like in the case of CVE-2026-33829, which impacted the Windows Snipping Tool's ms-screensketch: URI handler, the newly flagged issue resides in the search: URI handler, per Huntress.
